> Thanks Marissa - helpful summary. A couple quick clarifications before we schedule the tech call:

> - For Private (on-prem) deployments: does Redwood require outbound control-plane connectivity to your control plane, or can the control plane be fully customer-hosted (air-gapped)?
> - For Dedicated: what's the expected lift on our side for network / KMS integration? We use HashiCorp Vault and have strict egress rules.

Great questions - short answers below and I'll include them in the sizing doc attached. Happy to go deeper on the tech call.

- Private/on-prem: we support both models. The typical enterprise flow is a customer-hosted control plane (no outbound egress required) for air-gapped installs; we also offer a managed control plane option when customers prefer that (requires secure outbound connectivity).
- Dedicated (Redwood Dedicated): requires a private peering/VPN for data plane traffic plus KMS integration. We have documented integration guides for Vault; on our side we provide the SDK hooks and a deployment checklist. Typical infra lift for Dedicated is 1-2 infra engineers for a 2-3 week onboarding window.

Attached: a draft MA/scope (high level) so you have something to review before the tech sync. Proposed next step: 30-45 min tech sync with Samir + your security contact - I can send a calendar invite if you confirm availability (Tue/Wed next week ok?).

Regards,
Marissa
Attachment: draft-ma-scope.docx
